caveats: Paired at ONE seed (the tier's first); the ensemble value is quoted separately and is context, not the comparison.
NOT a test of the surface-coupling (phase-locking) collapse: the fiducial CloudModel has surf_coupling=0, so its screens are not rotationally locked and -0.198 cannot be reproduced or refuted here.
The Airy FWHM is set equal to the SGL image-plane pitch DIMG/n by construction; this is a matched-resolution swap, not a realistic conventional-telescope design study.
The Airy kernel is a far-field diffraction pattern; near-field SGL effects, solar J2/limb structure and occultation are neglected.
The forward operator is rebuilt from scratch, so operator-construction differences beyond the kernel itself may contribute to the loss.
Only the profiled solver is tested; white-noise and deflation baselines are not re-run under the alternative kernel.
